load_bearing_verifications.claim: The alanine and corn-steep-liquor-hydrolysate cordycepin effects belong to distinct solid-PDA CM01 and submerged GDMCC5.270 configurations; neither study measured pentostatin.
Turk 2022 reported 89.5 mg/g cordycepin on Allomyrina dichotoma, 34-fold over Bombyx mori, and a 51.4% increase after oleic-acid addition, but did not state the oleic-acid dose in the article text.
Hu 2017 reported 85.96% and 63.9% increases in its total ganoderic-acid assay after 1.5% microcrystalline cellulose and 0.5% D-galactose were added at 72 hours.

In Luo 2024, wood-log samples favored total triterpenoid peak area and combined lucidenic acids, while substitute samples favored ganosporelactone B; the comparison was not a controlled within-strain substrate swap.

Lee 2009 did not support a Pleurotus-cysteine row: 2 mM methionine significantly increased EGT in six of nine tested mushroom species, while the separately published Ganoderma neo-japonicum optimum used 4 mM methionine plus 1 g/L yeast extract and reached 2.4-fold control.

Wild-type Aspergillus oryzae RIB40 on solid DPY showed about a two-fold EGT increase at 0.1% methionine and 5.12 mg/g dry weight at 0.8%; the 20.03 mg/g and eight-fold result was a composite engineered-strain and medium-optimization result.

Lou 2021 reported configuration-dependent betulinic-acid effects from oleic acid and fungal elicitor, including 22.2-fold intracellular but only 129.7% higher total BA for the day-7 combination; its abstract and results conflict on the standalone elicitor magnitude.

Doar 2025 established an approximately two-orders-of-magnitude erinacine-C difference between dextrose/oatmeal complex medium and barley-malt minimal medium, but did not quantify an erinacine C:Q ratio because Q lacked an analytical standard.

The Pleurotus uridine and Hericium straw-formula studies were production results, not target-compound enhancements; the Hericium wood-free formula had slightly lower fresh yield and biological efficiency than its wood-chip control but shortened the first crop by 7 to 9 days.

limitations: This was a bounded claim audit of the existing SOP-7 registry and the directly implicated 2025 Aspergillus oryzae study, not a systematic review of all fungal medium optimization.
Several source studies used unaccessioned or private-library strains, limiting exact independent replication.
The Luo host-substrate comparison and Drenkhan field-conk comparison confound strain or site with substrate and therefore cannot establish transfer causality.
The Lou 2021 standalone fungal-elicitor magnitude remains unresolved because the abstract and results assign incompatible values; the candidate was retained without a quantitative expectation.
No non-English source supplied a load-bearing claim, so the two-model translation protocol was not triggered.
The scan audited cultivation evidence and transfer fidelity; it did not re-evaluate the gout relevance or clinical exposure of every listed compound.
